item.description: Ashley talks to Raakhee about creating something he wished existed for himself and his peers, how a test-and-learn approach changed their entire product, and how he registered the company after unexpectedly being accepted into an accelerator programme.

item.title: Tech for Good Podcast - Windfall Energy
item.description: Ashley discusses Windfall Energy’s mission to create affordable, installation-free home batteries for everyone.

item.title: Startups and SDGs
item.description: As an electronics engineer, you have a superpower: the ability to design and create technology that can change the world. Over the course of your career, you’ll spend around 80,000 hours working. That’s a significant portion of your life, and how you choose to spend that time matters. By aligning your work with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), you can ensure your 80,000 hours are dedicated to making a positive impact.
